Root.description:
Groups all parts of the accordion.
Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The uncontrolled value of the item(s) that should be initially expanded. To render a controlled accordion, use the `value` prop instead.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the item(s) that should be expanded. To render an uncontrolled accordion, use the `defaultValue` prop instead.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Event handler called when an accordion item is expanded or collapsed.
Provides the new value as an argument.

props.name: hiddenUntilFound
props.description:
Allows the browser's built-in page search to find and expand the panel contents. Overrides the `keepMounted` prop and uses `hidden="until-found"`
to hide the element without removing it from the DOM.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description:
Deprecated following the [APG guidance update](https://github.com/w3c/aria-practices/pull/3434)
to remove roving focus. This prop no longer affects keyboard focus behavior.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Whether multiple items can be open at the same time.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: orientation
props.description:
Deprecated following the [APG guidance update](https://github.com/w3c/aria-practices/pull/3434)
to remove roving focus. This prop no longer affects keyboard focus behavior.

props.name: class
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description:
Whether to keep the element in the DOM while the panel is closed.
This prop is ignored when `hiddenUntilFound` is used.

props.name: render
props.description: Replace the default element with a tag name, component, or render function.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: Indicates the orientation of the accordion.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the accordion is disabled.

additionalTypes.name: Root.State
Root.ChangeEventDetails

Trigger.description:
A button that opens and closes the corresponding panel.
Renders a `<button>` element.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description:
Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it
via the `render` prop.
Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).

Item.description:
Groups an accordion header with the corresponding panel.
Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: value
props.description:
A unique value that identifies this accordion item.
If no value is provided, a unique ID will be generated automatically.
Use when controlling the accordion programmatically, or to set an initial
open state.

props.name: onOpenChange
